rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an invitation or the act of inviting when no physical format is specified.

example.english: I received your invitation, thank you.
example.traditional: 我收到你嘅邀請，多謝你呀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou2 nei5 ge3 jiu1 cing2 do1 ze6 nei5 aa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a printed invitation card.

example.english: The invitation card is beautifully printed.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 jiu1 cing2 kaat1 jan3 dak1 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this for a traditional or social-event invitation, especially for a wedding or banquet.

example.english: Your wedding invitation is very thoughtful.
example.traditional: 你張結婚請帖好有心思。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 git3 fan1 cing2 tip3 hou2 jau5 sam1 si1

rows.note: Use this for an invitation sent as a letter rather than a card.

example.english: I received your invitation letter yesterday.
example.traditional: 我尋日收到你寄嚟嘅邀請信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 sau1 dou2 nei5 gei3 lei4 ge3 jiu1 cing2 seon3
